patchnote_2.1.0_item_1: 🩸 Speculative BAC visible on each beer card.
patchnote_2.1.0_item_3: 🚗 Driving indicator: waiting time until safe to drive.
patchnote_2.1.0_item_4: 📊 Premium info panel on each beer sheet (calories, pure alcohol, etc.).
patchnote_2.1.0_item_5: ⭐ Quick rating banner for unrated beers.
patchnote_2.1.0_item_6: ⏱️ New settings: drinking duration and vehicle type.
patchnote_2.5.0_item_1: 🌍 Full support for English and French languages.
patchnote_2.5.0_item_3: ⚡ Faster loading with skeleton screens and optimized assets.
patchnote_2.6.0_item_1: 🍺 Volume Presets: New grid UI in the tasting section with persistent storage.
patchnote_2.6.0_item_2: ⚡ Performance (Lazy Code): Drastic optimization of initial load time. Chart.js and secondary modules are now lazy-loaded.
patchnote_2.6.0_item_3: 🎡 Aroma Wheel: Full interactive SVG component (js/aroma-wheel.js) integrated into the rating block.
patchnote_2.6.0_item_4: ⌨️ Accessibility (A11Y): Focus Trap in modals, prefers-reduced-motion support, and keyboard-friendly UX.
patchnote_2.6.0_item_5: 🔍 Scanner Vision Plus: Full-screen omnidirectional scanner.
patchnote_2.7.0_item_1: 🏠 Home Screen Widget: Track your BAC level and sobriety time directly on your home screen.
patchnote_2.7.0_item_2: 📈 Dynamic Chart: Visualize your BAC curve and safety indicators without opening the app.
patchnote_2.7.0_item_3: ⚡ Real-time Sync: Instant widget updates when adding a drink or returning to the app.
patchnote_2.7.0_item_4: 🌎 Global Support: Widget deployed across all variants (Play Store, GitHub, Online/Offline).
patchnote_2.8.0_item_1: 🚲 Bicycle: New transport mode with tailored sanctions and safety messages.
patchnote_2.8.0_item_2: 📱 Autonomous Widget: Widget now works even without the calculator enabled, using safe defaults.
patchnote_2.8.0_item_3: 🎓 Enhanced Tutorial: Collects BAC info (weight, gender, country, vehicle), introduces the widget and improved navigation.
patchnote_2.8.0_item_4: 🚗 Vehicle-specific Warnings: Differentiated sanctions and alerts for car, motorcycle, bicycle and pedestrian.
patchnote_2.8.0_item_5: ⚡ Ultra-light Online APK: 70% size reduction for near-instant download and first launch.
patchnote_2.8.0_item_6: 🔧 Fixes: 5 missing translations added, tutorial positioning corrected.
patchnote_2.9.0_item_1: 💎 Premium UI: Aesthetic overhaul (Glassmorphism) of the global statistics cards and the equivalents dashboard.
patchnote_2.9.0_item_2: 🖱️ PC Ergonomics: Drag-to-Scroll capability and a stylized scrollbar added to the country selector.
patchnote_2.9.0_item_3: 🔙 Universal Navigation: Native support for the "Back" button (smartphone hardware and PWA browser) to close modals intelligently.
patchnote_2.9.0_item_4: 🔧 Fixes: Restored full-screen PC layout, repaired custom Wrapped cards, and adjusted default keg volume to 50cl.
patchnote_3.0.0_item_1: 🍺 Request a Beer: New form in settings to suggest beers to add to the Beerdex, with ready-to-use JSON payload for the database.
patchnote_3.0.0_item_2: 📷 Offline Scanning: Barcodes are now stored in the database. The scanner identifies beers locally without any API call.
patchnote_3.0.0_item_3: 🔙 Full Android Back Navigation: Back button now closes modals, search bar, and navigates between views before minimizing the app.
patchnote_3.0.0_item_4: 📱 Native Back Button: Overridden onBackPressed in all Android variants for seamless browser history-based navigation.
patchnote_3.0.0_item_5: 🔧 Enrichment Script: Automated barcode fetching tool from OpenFoodFacts for the entire beer database.

legal_tos_content: Beerdex is an informational, hobbyist, and non-commercial project. The information provided, especially by the BAC calculator, is for reference only and should never be considered as fact or evidence in a legal context. We decline all responsibility for misuse of the app or erroneous information. The user remains solely responsible for their consumption and actions.
legal_privacy_content: We collect anonymous data for statistical analysis purposes only. This data is never sold to third parties. Sensitive information such as weight, age, sex, or names is NEVER collected by our services: it remains stored locally on your device and is not accessible by the application or its authors.
legal_copyright_content: All rights to images and visuals used belong to the original breweries and photographers. In accordance with the Fair Use principle and the non-commercial scope of the project, we commit to removing any image within 24 hours upon explicit request from the legal rights holder. The source code, logo, and visual identity of Beerdex remain the exclusive property of its original authors.

patchnote_3.1.0_item_1: 🎮 Gamer BAC Profile: IRL Stats (Ping, FPS, Aim Assist, FOV, Resolution, Setup) with real-time and peak values.
patchnote_3.1.0_item_2: 🏆 Competitive Rank: IRL matchmaking based on your BAC (Global Elite → Wood Division).
patchnote_3.1.0_item_3: 📅 Full History: Chronological list view and interactive heatmap calendar.
patchnote_3.1.0_item_4: 🔥 Streak Counter: Dual-mode sobriety or party streak, toggleable.
patchnote_3.1.0_item_5: 👆 Interactivity: Click on a history or calendar entry to open the beer's detailed card.
patchnote_3.1.0_item_6: 📊 Individual History: View the complete consumption history of a beer directly in its detailed card.
patchnote_4.0.0_item_4: 📊 Tailored Statistics: Take control of your dashboard. The display order of all your stat blocks (Progression, History, BAC, Map, Streaks) is now 100% customizable via a simple drag-and-drop.
patchnote_4.0.0_item_3: 🍻 New additions to the Dex: The complete lineup from Brasserie Ardwen (Ambrée, Blanche, Blonde), the Lutgarde family (Blanche, Blonde, Fruitée, IPA, Pils, Triple), and Abbaye de Villers (III, V, IX) have joined the collection.
patchnote_4.0.0_item_2: 🧩 Modular Interface: Declutter your app by toggling major features on or off on the fly (Map of Thirst, Wrapped, Beer Match, Alcohol Equivalences).
patchnote_4.0.0_item_1: 🎨 Customization Engine: Beerdex is now YOUR Beerdex! Freely modify interface colors, change the app font, and apply unique themes (Cyberpunk, Forest, Blood Red...). You can even export and share your themes with friends!
patchnote_4.0.0_item_5: ⚙️ Advanced Diagnostic Mode: Integration of a new developer panel allowing the download of full logs into a .txt file, making technical support and bug fixing much easier.
patchnote_4.0.0_item_6: ⚡ Lightning Fast Startup & Localization: The deduplication engine now runs silently in the background, ensuring nearly instantaneous startup. Moreover, the seamless English/French bilingual support has been fully perfected.
